feed.h: Amazon to invest up to $25B more in Anthropic; Anthropic commits over $100B to AWS
feed.b: Amazon said it is investing $5 billion in Anthropic now and up to $20 billion more tied to commercial milestones. In return, Anthropic committed to spend more than $100 billion on AWS over ten years and secured up to 5 gigawatts of Amazon Trainium capacity. The investment money and the cloud spending flow in opposite directions between the same two companies.

src.t: Amazon and Anthropic expand strategic collaboration
Amazon puts up to $25 billion more into Anthropic and secures 10-year cloud commitment in return

feed.h: Anthropic signs Google and Broadcom deal for about 3.5 GW of TPU capacity from 2027
feed.b: Anthropic announced an agreement with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity starting in 2027, mostly sited in the U.S. DCD, citing a Broadcom filing, puts it at 3.5 gigawatts and reports Broadcom will develop Google TPUs through 2031. Financial terms were not disclosed.

src.t: Anthropic expands Google and Broadcom compute deal
Broadcom to develop Google TPUs until 2031; Anthropic signs deal with both companies for 3.5GW of TPUs
